#====================================================================================================
# START - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

# THIS SECTION CONTAINS CRITICAL TESTING INSTRUCTIONS FOR BOTH AGENTS
# BOTH MAIN_AGENT AND TESTING_AGENT MUST PRESERVE THIS ENTIRE BLOCK

# Communication Protocol:
# If the `testing_agent` is available, main agent should delegate all testing tasks to it.
#
# You have access to a file called `test_result.md`. This file contains the complete testing state
# and history, and is the primary means of communication between main and the testing agent.
#
# Main and testing agents must follow this exact format to maintain testing data. 
# The testing data must be entered in yaml format Below is the data structure:
# 
## user_problem_statement: {problem_statement}
## backend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.py"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## frontend:
##   - task: "Task name"
##     implemented: true
##     working: true  # or false or "NA"
##     file: "file_path.js"
##     stuck_count: 0
##     priority: "high"  # or "medium" or "low"
##     needs_retesting: false
##     status_history:
##         -working: true  # or false or "NA"
##         -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##         -comment: "Detailed comment about status"
##
## metadata:
##   created_by: "main_agent"
##   version: "1.0"
##   test_sequence: 0
##   run_ui: false
##
## test_plan:
##   current_focus:
##     - "Task name 1"
##     - "Task name 2"
##   stuck_tasks:
##     - "Task name with persistent issues"
##   test_all: false
##   test_priority: "high_first"  # or "sequential" or "stuck_first"
##
## agent_communication:
##     -agent: "main"  # or "testing" or "user"
##     -message: "Communication message between agents"

# Protocol Guidelines for Main agent
#
# 1. Update Test Result File Before Testing:
#    - Main agent must always update the `test_result.md` file before calling the testing agent
#    - Add implementation details to the status_history
#    - Set `needs_retesting` to true for tasks that need testing
#    - Update the `test_plan` section to guide testing priorities
#    - Add a message to `agent_communication` explaining what you've done
#
# 2. Incorporate User Feedback:
#    - When a user provides feedback that something is or isn't working, add this information to the relevant task's status_history
#    - Update the working status based on user feedback
#    - If a user reports an issue with a task that was marked as working, increment the stuck_count
#    - Whenever user reports issue in the app, if we have testing agent and task_result.md file so find the appropriate task for that and append in status_history of that task to contain the user concern and problem as well 
#
# 3. Track Stuck Tasks:
#    - Monitor which tasks have high stuck_count values or where you are fixing same issue again and again, analyze that when you read task_result.md
#    - For persistent issues, use websearch tool to find solutions
#    - Pay special attention to tasks in the stuck_tasks list
#    - When you fix an issue with a stuck task, don't reset the stuck_count until the testing agent confirms it's working
#
# 4. Provide Context to Testing Agent:
#    - When calling the testing agent, provide clear instructions about:
#      - Which tasks need testing (reference the test_plan)
#      - Any authentication details or configuration needed
#      - Specific test scenarios to focus on
#      - Any known issues or edge cases to verify
#
# 5. Call the testing agent with specific instructions referring to test_result.md
#
# IMPORTANT: Main agent must ALWAYS update test_result.md BEFORE calling the testing agent, as it relies on this file to understand what to test next.

#====================================================================================================
# END - Testing Protocol - DO NOT EDIT OR REMOVE THIS SECTION
#====================================================================================================

metadata:
  created_by: "main_agent"
  version: "1.4"
  test_sequence: 5
  run_ui: false

  - task: "Phase 5A Backend — Shipment/Trip lifecycle: POD requirement + confirm-to-COMPLETED + dispute + lazy auto-completion"
    implemented: true
    working: true
    file: "backend/server.py, backend/models.py, backend/extra.py"
    stuck_count: 0
    priority: "high"
    needs_retesting: false
    status_history:
        - working: "NA"
          agent: "main"
          comment: "PHASE 5A CHANGES (surgical, additive): (1) POST /api/trips/{id}/status now REQUIRES pod_photo (base64 data URL string) when target status = DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION → 400 POD_REQUIRED otherwise. Persists trip.delivery_proof={photo,notes,delivered_by_id,delivered_by_name,lat,lng,at} + emits audit action TRIP_POD_SUBMITTED. Also rejects any state change if trip already in TERMINAL_STATES (DELIVERED, COMPLETED, CANCELLED, DISPUTED) → 400 TRIP_IN_TERMINAL_STATE. Linear TRIP_FLOW enforcement + driver ownership check remain intact. (2) POST /api/trips/{id}/confirm-delivery now transitions directly DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION → COMPLETED (skipping the previously sticky DELIVERED-only state). Uses conditional findOneAndUpdate to prevent double-confirm race. Immediately fires record_trip_completion() so the ledger is created on confirm (not on rating). Persists delivery_confirmation={reference,confirmed_at,confirmed_by,confirmed_by_id,lat,lng,delivered_to_name,auto:false}. Emits audit TRIP_DELIVERY_CONFIRMED. Rating remains optional. (3) POST /api/trips/{id}/dispute (NEW, customer only): body {reason,notes}. Allowed only when trip.status = DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION → transitions trip + shipment to DISPUTED. Stores trip.dispute={reason,notes,opened_by_id,opened_by_name,opened_at}. Audit TRIP_DISPUTED. Notifies driver + all admins. Guards: 400 DISPUTE_REASON_REQUIRED for empty reason. (4) LAZY AUTO-COMPLETION via _maybe_auto_complete(trip) called at the top of GET /api/trips/mine and GET /api/trips/{id}. If a trip has been in DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION for more than settings.auto_complete_hours (default 48), atomically claims and transitions COMPLETED (auto_completed=true, customer_confirmed=true) with the ledger fired, TRIP_AUTO_COMPLETED audit entry, and a customer notification. No background scheduler. (5) POST /api/trips/{id}/review now accepts status in {DELIVERED, COMPLETED} (was DELIVERED-only). record_trip_completion is idempotent (already checked). (6) get_settings() in extra.py auto-seeds auto_complete_hours=48 if missing (backward compatible)."
        - working: true
          agent: "testing"
          comment: "✅ ALL PHASE 5A BACKEND TESTS PASSED (6 sections, 40+ test cases). Comprehensive testing via /app/backend_test_phase5a.py covering all requirements. RESULTS: [A] HAPPY PATH (10/10 PASS): ✅ A1-A3: Shipment creation, bid submission, bid acceptance, trip creation working. ✅ A4: Linear trip flow advancement to DRIVER_ARRIVED_DESTINATION working (7 states). ✅ A5: POD_REQUIRED enforced - POST /trips/{id}/status without pod_photo returns 400 'POD_REQUIRED'. ✅ A6: POD submission with pod_photo + pod_notes returns 200, trip.status=DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION, trip.delivery_proof contains photo/notes/delivered_by_name/at. ✅ A7: Customer confirm-delivery transitions directly to COMPLETED (not DELIVERED), customer_confirmed=true, completed_at set. ✅ A8: Ledger created on confirm - 3 transactions (customer_payment, platform_commission, driver_earning), idempotent. ✅ A9: Rating still works after COMPLETED - POST /trips/{id}/review returns 200. ✅ A10: Audit log contains TRIP_POD_SUBMITTED and TRIP_DELIVERY_CONFIRMED entries. [B] POD REJECTION EDGE CASES (5/5 PASS): ✅ B2: No pod_photo/pod_notes → 400 POD_REQUIRED. ✅ B3: Empty string pod_photo → 400 POD_REQUIRED. ✅ B4: Whitespace only pod_photo → 400 POD_REQUIRED. ✅ B5: Valid pod_photo → 200. Duplicate POD submission → 400 INVALID_TRIP_TRANSITION. [C] DISPUTE PATH (8/8 PASS): ✅ C2: Empty reason → 400 DISPUTE_REASON_REQUIRED. ✅ C3: Valid dispute → 200, trip.status=DISPUTED, trip.dispute.reason preserved. ✅ C4: Shipment status also DISPUTED. ✅ C5: Ledger NOT triggered for disputed trip (0 transactions). ✅ C6: Post-dispute actions blocked - driver cannot advance (400 TRIP_IN_TERMINAL_STATE), customer cannot confirm (400), customer cannot dispute again (400/409). ✅ C7: Audit log contains TRIP_DISPUTED with reason and actor=customer. ✅ C8: Admin notification for dispute present (type=trip_disputed). [D] LAZY AUTO-COMPLETION (6/6 PASS): ✅ D2: Simulated stale trip (delivered_pending_at 3 days ago) - GET /trips/{id} returns status=COMPLETED, auto_completed=true. ✅ D3: Ledger fired for auto-completed trip (3 transactions). ✅ D4: Audit log contains TRIP_AUTO_COMPLETED with elapsed_hours in new_value. ✅ D5: Customer notification for auto-completion present (type=trip_auto_completed). ✅ D6: Fresh trip (recent delivered_pending_at) NOT auto-completed - status remains DELIVERED_PENDING_CONFIRMATION. [E] AUTHORIZATION (4/4 PASS): ✅ E1: Customer2 cannot confirm/dispute/GET trip owned by customer1 (404). ✅ E2: Driver2 cannot update trip owned by driver1 (404). ✅ E3: Driver cannot dispute (403, customer-only endpoint). ✅ E4: Customer cannot update trip status (403, driver-only endpoint). [F] LEGACY/BACKWARDS COMPAT (3/3 PASS): ✅ F2: All admin endpoints return 200 (/admin/stats, /admin/shipments, /admin/bids, /admin/trips, /admin/finance/stats, /admin/finance/transactions, /admin/roles, /admin/audit-logs, /admin/documents). ✅ F3: OTP + admin login still working (200). ✅ F4: Shipment creation, publishing, bidding, acceptance, trip status update flow still working (200). NO CRITICAL ISSUES. All Phase 5A backend features working correctly. POD requirement enforced. Confirm-to-COMPLETED transition working. Dispute path working with ledger skipped. Lazy auto-completion working. Authorization matrix enforced. Backwards compatibility maintained."
